verses.1:
A Psalm of David.
 The earth is the LORD’s, and the fullness thereof, + 24:1 Cited in 1 Corinthians 10:26|1CO 10:26 
 the world and all who dwell therein.
verses.2:
For He has founded it upon the seas
 and established it upon the waters.
verses.3:
Who may ascend the hill of the LORD?
 Who may stand in His holy place?
verses.4:
He who has clean hands and a pure heart,
 who does not lift up his soul to an idol + 24:4 Or to falsehood or to vanity 
 or swear deceitfully.
verses.5:
He will receive blessing from the LORD
 and vindication from the God of his salvation.
verses.6:
Such is the generation of those who seek Him,
 who seek Your face, O God of Jacob. + 24:6 LXX, Syriac, and two Hebrew manuscripts; MT who seek your face, O Jacob 
 Selah
verses.7:
Lift up your heads, O gates!
 Be lifted up, O ancient doors,
 that the King of Glory may enter!
verses.8:
Who is this King of Glory?
 The LORD strong and mighty,
 the LORD mighty in battle.
verses.9:
Lift up your heads, O gates!
 Be lifted up, O ancient doors,
 that the King of Glory may enter!
verses.10:
Who is He, this King of Glory?
 The LORD of Hosts —
 He is the King of Glory.
 Selah

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
